# AbiaConnect

> A community forum connecting indigenous people of Abia State, both at home and abroad.

AbiaConnect is an online community where Abians worldwide discuss culture, news, events, and ideas across categories, threads, polls, and subgroups.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest discussions, featured threads, and community highlights.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to your AbiaConnect account.
- [Register](/register): Create a new AbiaConnect account.

## Optional

- [Forgot password](/forgot-password): Reset your account password.
